// Fixed non-source witnesses for the seven explicit resource management
// rows that ADR 0016 excludes, derived from pinned Test262. Each section
// keeps the original assertions and replaces only the source-compiling
// call: `new other.Function()` and `new Function()` become a literal
// function, and each `eval` becomes a literal ADR 0029 host Script.

// Replacement for test/built-ins/DisposableStack/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var newTarget = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
var stack;

newTarget.prototype = undefined;
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is undefined');

newTarget.prototype = null;
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is null');

newTarget.prototype = true;
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Boolean');

newTarget.prototype = '';
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a String');

newTarget.prototype = Symbol();
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Symbol');

newTarget.prototype = 1;
stack = Reflect.construct(DisposableStack, [], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(stack), other.DisposableStack.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Number');
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/SuppressedError/proto-from-ctor-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var newTarget = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
var err;

newTarget.prototype = undefined;
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is undefined');

newTarget.prototype = null;
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is null');

newTarget.prototype = true;
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Boolean');

newTarget.prototype = '';
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a String');

newTarget.prototype = Symbol();
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Symbol');

newTarget.prototype = 0;
err = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [[]], newTarget);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(err), other.SuppressedError.prototype, 'newTarget.prototype is a Number');
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/SuppressedError/newtarget-proto-fallback.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
const values = [
  undefined,
  null,
  42,
  false,
  true,
  Symbol(),
  'string',
  SuppressedError.prototype,
];

const NewTarget = function () {};

for (const value of values) {
  const NewTargetProxy = new Proxy(NewTarget, {
    get(t, p) {
      if (p === 'prototype') {
        return value;
      }
      return t[p];
    }
  });

  const error = Reflect.construct(SuppressedError, [], NewTargetProxy);
  assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(error), SuppressedError.prototype);
}
})();

// Replacement for test/language/statements/using/cptn-value.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
assert.sameValue(
  $262.evalScript('{using test262id1 = null;}'), undefined, 'Single declaration'
);
assert.sameValue(
  $262.evalScript('{using test262id2 = null, test262id3 = null;}'),
  undefined,
  'Multiple declarations'
);

assert.sameValue($262.evalScript('4; {using test262id5 = null;}'), 4);
assert.sameValue($262.evalScript('6; {using test262id7 = null, test262id8 = null;}'), 6);
})();

// Replacement for
// test/language/statements/using/syntax/using-not-allowed-at-top-level-of-eval.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
assert.throws(SyntaxError, function() {
  $262.evalScript('using x = null;')
});
})();

// Replacement for
// test/language/statements/await-using/syntax/await-using-not-allowed-at-top-level-of-eval.js
// Copyright (C) 2023 Ron Buckton. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
// The original runs under asyncTest; the rejection is checked here and the
// completion line waits for it.
var awaitUsing = (async function () {
  try {
    await (async function () {
      $262.evalScript('await using x = null;')
    })();
  } catch (error) {
    assert.sameValue(error.constructor, SyntaxError, 'rejects with SyntaxError');
    return;
  }
  throw new Test262Error('Expected a SyntaxError rejection');
})();

awaitUsing.then(function () {
  console.log("disposal dynamic source complete");
}, function (error) {
  console.log("disposal dynamic source failed: " + error);
});
